notes.title: VIP UNLOCK 11/12
notes.content:
This update will unlock the rest of the intended content for 1.4.  Thank you everyone for your support of Prodigal.  Bugs and tweaks will continue to fixed as needed but with this update the extended content for Prodigal is concluded.  Thank you.

- You can now get on the list for the VIP area.
- The elite feats can now be accessed in the VIP area.
- Croc run winner NPCs have been added.
- NEW NPC: Aura has been added.

notes.title: ONE SMALL PATCH 1.4 10/3/21
notes.content:
-FEATURES-
- Started update of Crocodile upstairs.
- Peppo.
- Added Uros.
- A new challenge has been added for those who have conquered 4 altars as well as the Daemon's Dive.
- The right room of Crocasino upstairs has been redone in preparation of something for later.
- Crocasino VIP area has been added.  You are not on the list and currently cannot get on the list.

-FIXES-
- Caroline should no longer ghost walk through the entirety of Pirates Pier.
- Once again made tweaks to improve startup time.
- Fixed an issue causing Tara to ask for additional small favors.
- True end and Hero's Rest end tracks should no longer carry over into the overworld.
- You should no longer be able to be smote after finishing Mariana's challenges.
- Moved interacts on right side of museum so the top interact can be touched.
- Changed the bunnies in Caroline scene.
- Changed spike balls for Inkwell and Dive Rat Potion so lariat doesn't stick.
- Added 2 pixels to fist dash.
- Fixed text errors.
- Started work on fixing certain text breaks and ports.
- Arena challenges should no longer respawn on player in rare cases.
- Feat icon no longer flipped.
- The small key chest in Bjerg should no longer be affected by chaos altar to prevent being trapped in the dungeon.
- You can no longer get beyond damage cap.
- Crabs should no longer occasionally walk on air.
- Hate death no longer enables zombie Oran.
- Made some tweaks to fix drops.
- Death during a jingle should no long cause it to loop until next song zone is entered.
- Actions immediately after heart ores should no longer cause strange things to happen.
- Base movement speed has been increased.
- Camera movement should now feel a bit smoother. 
- Added a room skip in Daemon’s Dive casino area.
- Added v-sync option.
- Murder Mystery start should no longer briefly show the graveyard.
- Murder Mystery intro scene now shows when initiated from inside a building.
- Combat challenge in Haunted House now correctly waits for all skeletons to die.
- Dying on ice will no longer cause the player to spin endlessly until ice is encountered again.
- To reduce confusion for new players a hearty salmon meal will now also fully heal you.
- Damage while on ice that knocks the player off ice and onto solid ground should no longer lock the player in the spin animation.
- Oran should no longer occasionally zombie rise on death while visiting the Bjerg.
- Nora should correctly hint the player in postgame if never met before that point.
- Death at the moment of combat challenge completions will no longer fail to grant victory when resurrected by cobbler.
- The Rat Potion will now reset and be damaged as punishment for scurrying out of his arena.
- Players can no long pause during Hate deaths to attempt to avoid fate.
- Title music will no longer restart when starting a new game.
- Biggun will no longer fall in pits while jumping.
- Puzzle jingles will no longer loop in Crystal Cave.

notes.title: Gods and Gamblers
notes.content:
[h1]Gods and Gamblers[/h1]

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
We heard you loud and clear, and have included a new way to increase the difficulty in your game! After you've beaten the game at least once, you'll meet a robed stranger who will lead you to a way to offend the Gods. And they will make you pay for it.

[h3]New Character[/h3]
A stranger has come to Vann's point on a mission, although she may find bunnies a bit more distracting. Make sure to check up on the sheriff's office during Act 2 in order to see how you can help.

[h3]Tara[/h3]
Tara has a new plan up her sleeve, one involving the rich and beautiful Ashwood. Make sure to also talk to her in Act 2 to see what she has in store.

[h3]New Minigames[/h3]
We've added two new minigames to the Crocasino! Clementine and Illy are here to make your life even better, and hey, at least they aren't rigged.

[h3]Crocodile[/h3]
Lastly, rumor has it, Crocodile has shown up in Vann's Point, and has allowed visitors inside his 'collection'. If you're lucky, he may even let you in his backroom - where treasure awaits!

We hope you enjoy this new update as much as we do, and can't wait to show you more in the future!
